title: dysoxylum patersonianum
intro: Dysoxylum patersonianum, commonly known as the Paterson's Dysoxylum or Paterson's Dyso, is a species of plant in the family Meliaceae. This plant is a tree native to Australia and is traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Dysoxylum patersonianum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can be used to treat various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and triterpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties.
